title: Bug: [SmartSwitch] IP will not be assigned on midplane after DPU Image Upgrade from 202505 -> 202506+
author: vivekkarri
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

DHCP Server on NPU is not assigning Ip to DPU after upgrade from 202505 -> 202506+

### Steps to Reproduce

1) Install Image on NPU, setup smartswitch config and start dhcp_server 
2) Install 202505 on DPU / or power on DPU which has 202505 by default
3) NPU assigns IP to DPU
4) Install 202506 image.
5) Check if IP is not assigned and is accessible from NPU

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

IP will not be assigned to DPU. IP will be assigned after 3600 sec (This is lease expiration time) from the time of Step #3.  This is often too late and service will be started with incorrent database config and can lead to crash in DPU

### Triage
Happening because of this change where the Client-ID in the DHCP request is different between 202505/202506

Change was made here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23805

And the dhcp_server thinks the request is coming from a new device and it doesn't allocate the IP until the original lease expires

Where the ClientIdentifier was explicitly set to mac
[midplane-network-dpu.network](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/23805/files#diff-687aa19d3525dfd9c111c920761f1967dbbdf9971463491ac40c4b2dd78ee26f)
```
[DHCPv4]
ClientIdentifier=mac
```

### Potential WA
One of these can be run after step#4, to WA this problem
1) Reboot NPU after installing DPU
2) Restart DHCP server service on NPU

### Relevant log output

```shell
>>> 202505

20:08:16.937472 bridge-midplane B   IP (tos 0xc0, ttl 64, id 0, offset 0, flags [none], proto UDP (17), length 315)
    0.0.0.0.bootpc > 255.255.255.255.bootps: BOOTP/DHCP, Request from b0:cf:0e:0e:fb:e3 (oui Unknown), length 287, xid 0x12701781, secs 64, Flags [none]
      Client-Ethernet-Address b0:cf:0e:0e:fb:e3 (oui Unknown)
        DHCP-Message (53), length 1: Discover
        Client-ID (61), length 19: hardware-type 255, 7d:8b:3d:bb:00:02:00:00:ab:11:fa:f9:e1:2a:e5:84:2a:71
        Hostname (12), length 5: "sonic"

>>> 202506
        
        Client-ID (61), length 19: hardware-type 255, 01:b0:cf:0e:0e:fb:e3
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

comments.author: oleksandrivantsiv
comments.body: @prsunny, @prabhataravind this is a blocker for the 202506 release from our point of view. After the upgrade, the DPU does not get an IP and SONiC does not start.

comments.author: prabhataravind
comments.body:
@SahilChaudhari could you please take a look at this issue at priority? It looks like the client identifier change from DUID to mac address causes issues when upgrading the DPUs from 202505 (which doesn't have the change) to 202506 (with the change).
We have some factory shipments with 202505 image which doesn't have this fix, so cherry-picking this to 202505 also may not be sufficient. Can we revert this change?
